privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Smart Sequence Tech
privacy.description: ForgeHelm Privacy Policy — GDPR, CCPA, and Taiwan PDPA aligned data governance for enterprise customers.

blocks.text: {studioNameEn} ({studioName}) operates ForgeHelm, a code governance and compliance platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect personal data when you use smartsequence.tech or the ForgeHelm SaaS service. It addresses GDPR (EU 2016/679), CCPA (California), and Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA). For website visitors and billing data, we are the data controller; for data uploaded by SaaS customers or transmitted by the analysis engine, we are the processor and the customer is the controller.

bullets: Contact form: Name, business email, company, job title, headcount, plan of interest, inquiry type, and message content (received by the form service Web3Forms and forwarded to us)
Analytics: The website currently uses no analytics or tracking scripts
Cookies: The website sets no cookies; language and light/dark theme preferences are stored only in your browser's local storage
Account data: Business email, name, company, role, subscription plan
Usage data: Feature logs, login times, API records
Billing data: Processed by payment provider; we do not store full card numbers
Support data: Tickets and correspondence

Hybrid, on-premises, and air-gapped deployments: the analysis engine (Agent) analyzes code in your environment, and only masked file names, line numbers, and summary counts are sent to the SaaS platform; we do not receive source code

Cloud-only Core and trial plans: repositories you upload or specify are accessed by our hosted analysis engine for the duration of the analysis; the retention period follows your written agreement with us, and absent one, you may request deletion by email
We do not collect GDPR Art. 9 special categories of personal data
Respond to demo, PoC, and sales inquiries
Provision and operate ForgeHelm SaaS accounts
Issue invoices and process subscriptions
Provide support and maintain reliability
Send service-critical notifications (not marketing unless opted in)
Meet legal and tax obligations

rows: Source code uploaded on Core / trial plans
Duration of the analysis; retention period per written agreement, deletion available on request by email
blocks.note: You may request early deletion of non-billing data (see Section 7).

bullets: Vercel: Marketing site hosting (EU/US; DPA in place)
Stripe: Subscription billing (PCI-DSS Level 1)
Web3Forms: Contact form delivery (United States)
Google Gemini API: Vector indexing and inference for cloud AI mode (Core, and Professional without a customer-provided model)
paragraphs: We sign data processing agreements with sub-processors that handle personal data. Any prospective or current customer may request the sub-processor list by email; hosting location details for the ForgeHelm SaaS management platform are also available on request.

blocks.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights:

items.title: Access
items.desc: Request a copy of data we hold about you

items.title: Portability
items.desc: Receive data in a structured, machine-readable format

items.title: Objection
items.desc: Object to processing based on legitimate interest

items.title: Restriction
items.desc: Request limited processing while a dispute is resolved

paragraphs: California residents may opt out of sale/sharing under the CCPA. We do not sell personal data.

Under Taiwan's PDPA, you may request to access or review your data, obtain copies, supplement or correct it, and have collection, processing, or use stopped and the data deleted; data portability is a right we provide under the GDPR, and Taiwan customers may exercise it as well.

Contact {email}. We handle access and copy requests within 15 days and correction, deletion, and cessation-of-processing requests within 30 days; where the GDPR applies, its one-month deadline governs.

rows: No cookies set; language and theme preferences stored in your browser's local storage
blocks.note: We do not use analytics, advertising, or cross-site tracking cookies.

paragraphs: With hybrid, on-premises, or air-gapped deployment, source code and analysis stay in the customer's environment and only masked compliance metrics reach the SaaS platform; on cloud-only Core and trial plans, source code is analyzed in our hosted environment.
Where account/billing data leaves the EEA or Taiwan, we rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses, adequacy decisions, or Taiwan PDPA contractual safeguards.

bullets: Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+
Encryption at rest: Cloud databases use the hosting provider's storage-layer encryption; secret fields such as authentication tokens are additionally encrypted at the field level
Access control: RBAC for personnel
Audit logs: Administrative actions are written to a hash-chained audit log whose integrity can be verified
Vulnerability management: Regular scanning and dependency updates
paragraphs: In the event of a personal data breach, as controller we notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours under GDPR Art. 33 and promptly notify affected individuals under Art. 34 and Article 12 of Taiwan's PDPA; as processor, we promptly notify the customer under Art. 33(2). Enterprise and government customers may agree to different notification deadlines by contract.

bullets: Published on this page with an updated effective date
Active SaaS customers notified by email at least 30 days before material changes

paragraphs: Under the GDPR, you may lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority where you live.
